lf-motion.description: Shared sticky playback controls for authored animations or video comparisons, with play, pause, replay, speed and a timeline. Its body holds all compared previews.
lf-motion.x-instructions: Put videos or authored illustrations in the body. Videos need no script: use muted playsinline, omit autoplay, loop and individual controls, and give duration in milliseconds for the full study. The shared transport plays all descendant videos, seeks them together and stays visible while the body scrolls. For illustrations, wait for customElements.whenDefined('lf-motion'), then assign element.renderFrame = time => { ... }. It receives milliseconds from 0 to duration and draws a complete frame synchronously, including when seeking backward; assignment draws immediately. Read or set currentTime to inspect an exact instant; setting it pauses and clamps to the duration. Playback starts paused and remains local inspection state. Compose inside lf-playground-preview around candidate choices; the playground submits the selected candidate and tunable settings, never playback time or speed. Describe what the previews demonstrate; use lf-trace when readers need captured checkpoints and their inspection tools.
